meta.policy: Needs review items are published here and do not block integration. Blank cells anywhere on this site map to one of these flags.

flags.title: Private facts unknown - personal tax and eligibility cannot be computed
flags.detail: Balance amount, income composition, PRC tax paid, US filing/FBAR history, residency status and account ownership were not provided. No personal tax amount, net-USD outcome or cheapest-provider claim is certified. All such cells are blank.

flags.title: Document-based limits depend on your documents
flags.detail: M01's convertible amount equals the documented lawful income; Wise's overall limit equals documented after-China-tax salary; emigrant/inheritor transfers are limited to the SAFE-approved amount. None is a fixed public number.

flags.title: Unpublished commercial costs - left blank, never estimated
flags.detail: FX spread (board-rate margin), correspondent/receiving-bank charges, Wise fees, Western Union fees/limits, ATM issuer/operator fees, offshore RMB conversion rates, travel costs and SAFE-process fees are not statically published by an official/primary source. Every such cell is blank. The computed 'published fee' columns are fee floors from published tariffs only - NOT all-in costs.

flags.title: Quota wording nuance for foreign individuals
flags.detail: SAFE's 2007 English press conference describes the sales quota for domestic and foreign individuals; the 2024 Tianjin FAQ says only Foreign Permanent Resident ID holders enjoy the purchase facilitation quota; the FX Regulations Art. 52 definition includes foreigners resident 1 full year as 'domestic individuals'. Purchase-side treatment of long-resident foreign passport holders should be confirmed with the bank/SAFE before relying on M02.

flags.title: Emigrant transfer eligibility is narrow (analysis)
flags.detail: 移民财产转移 covers emigrants FROM Mainland China (assets acquired before immigration permission, hukou cancellation proofs). A US-born citizen who never held PRC residency generally does not fit this definition. Confirm with SAFE if you believe you qualify.

flags.title: Inherited repo claims that overstate the rules (not edited - other sessions own those files)
flags.detail: reports/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY_85f37d08.md line 15 generalizes the USD 500/day rule to any US citizen without paperwork; SAFE restricts it to reconversion of previously exchanged unused RMB (S04). Line 49's categorical '0% if already taxed' and unqualified FTC claims need the S20 limit and S15 income-category caveats. Concurrent audit sessions (audit-252753e7, audit-86f0) raised the same issues on their branches. Owners were notified via COORDINATION.md; files preserved unedited.

flags.title: Western Union bank-account delivery temporarily unavailable at retrieval
flags.detail: The provider page displayed a banner: transfers to recipient bank accounts temporarily unavailable - choose another delivery method (cash pickup). Availability can change; re-check before relying on M05.

flags.title: HSBC tariff PDF contains mixed version headers
flags.detail: The retrieved PDF cover says effective 31 Oct 2026 while an internal section header says effective 12 Sep 2024. Cited items (2.2.4.x, 2.2.6.1, 2.2.2.1) were read from the retrieved version; confirm current fees with the bank before executing. Provider tariffs change at the bank's discretion (Important Note 2).

flags.title: IRS FEIE webpage lists stale amounts
flags.detail: The IRS FEIE page text lists exclusion amounts only through 2023 (USD 120,000). The 2026 amount (USD 132,900) is taken from Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.39 (S22), fetched directly. Do not use the webpage's old figures for current planning.

flags.title: RMB 20,000 carry limit verified via PBOC Q&A and government republication, not the announcement text
flags.detail: PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 18 itself was not retrieved; the 20,000/trip figure is confirmed by the PBOC's official Q&A (S11) and a State Council office republication (S12). High confidence, but the primary announcement text remains for manual review.

flags.title: Statute edition and currency-gain character need professional confirmation
flags.detail: 26 USC 988 was read from the 2024 US Code edition (govinfo). Current applicability, and the character (capital vs ordinary) of personal FX gain above USD 200, were not verified from Publication 525 this session. The USD 200 nonrecognition threshold itself is statutory text (S24 (e)(2)).

flags.title: Parallel dashboards in this repo disagree on method counts
flags.detail: data/methods.json has 18 routes; research/findings.json 67 findings across 22 routes; reports ledger 22 methods; portal pages 17 methods per earlier board notes. Each dashboard passes its own structural validator, but counts and some claims differ across sessions. This site (repatriate/) publishes its own 17-method catalog with per-row sources; prior dashboards are preserved unedited as parallel-session work. Repo links: https://github.com/sassnarep3-star/China2/blob/main/data/methods.json , https://github.com/sassnarep3-star/China2/blob/main/reports/CNY_TO_USD_RESEARCH_LEDGER.json

flags.title: FBAR penalty amounts are inflation-adjusted annually
flags.detail: S19 table values (USD 16,536 non-willful / USD 165,353 willful) apply to penalties assessed on/after 2025-01-17; eCFR current through 2026-11-05. Re-check at assessment time. Willful statutory alternative is 50% of account balance (S18).

flags.title: Reference exchange rate is for comparison only
flags.detail: All CNY->USD fee conversions on this site use the IRS 2025 yearly average (7.129). The IRS states it has no official exchange rate. Actual conversion happens at the bank/provider's live rate, which is unpublished (F03). Computed USD fee figures are reference conversions, not quotes.

flags.title: Research, not personalized advice
flags.detail: Nothing here is personalized tax or legal advice; no funds were moved and no returns filed. Provider terms describe that provider only. Engage a qualified US/PRC tax professional before executing, especially for FTC/FEIE positions, FBAR catch-up (S26/S27) and large transfers.
